## Hộp thoại approval trong TUI (e6, sau PermissionRequest)
   Would you like to run the following command? Environment: local Reason: Do you want to allow creating ../outside-approval.txt outside the workspace? $ touch ../outside-approval.txt › 1. Yes, proceed (y) 2. Yes, and don't ask again for commands that start with `touch ../outside-approval.txt` ( p ) 3. No, and tell Codex what to do differently ( esc ) Press enter to confirm or esc to cancel

## Hộp thoại cập nhật khi KHÔNG có -c check_for_update_on_startup=false (e2) — Enter = Update now
   Update available · 0.163.0 → 0.164.0 Release notes: https://github.com/openai/codex/releases/latest › 1. Update now (runs `sh -c 'curl -fsSL https://chatgpt.com/codex/install.sh | CODEX_NON_INTERACTIVE=1 sh'`) 2. Skip 3. Skip until next version enter continue · esc skip Updating Codex

## Cảnh báo F2 khi dùng -c mà không --no-daemon
   Warnings · 1 of 1 · Startup Running without the shared background server: command-line configuration overrides (-c, --enable, --disable, or --search) requires embedded mode. k keep & next · esc dismiss & close · ^o copy · ←/→ warning · ↓ scroll
